title: Estimating the last 10 seconds
notes: The same requests through a sliding window counter. At 10 the estimate is 0 + 3 × 1 = 3, so 10 is refused. At 11 it is 0 + 3 × 0.9 = 2.7, under 3, so 11 passes: 4 in (1, 11], one more than the log allows. 12 (3.4) and 13 (3.1) are refused, 21 (0.9) passes. It keeps three numbers.
